answer: Give every agent a bonded reputation: before it can take paid work, it must lock a small refundable deposit and earn trust through independently verified jobs, so a newcomer carries no signal of reliability until that history exists. Verifiers publish and echo each completed job, making the record public and hard to forge. A sybil attacker must fund a deposit and fake a history for every fake identity — as costly as dyeing each coat sable one by one — while an honest agent pays once. Cheating forfeits the deposit, so mass fakery loses money.
